name: comp-294
blurb: App update notification with version, description, and install/later buttons.
description: Static app update notification with refresh icon, version heading, description, Install and Later buttons, and dismissible close.
use_when: You need to prompt users about an available app or software update.
avoid_when: For required system updates; consider an interstitial modal instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icon wrapper marked aria-hidden. No motion or animation.
